##### Project general facts

Purvanchal Sunbliss Residences is a thoughtfully designed residential development by Purvanchal Real Estate Developers, located in Al Furjan, Dubai, just steps away from the metro station. The project features a ground floor, one podium level, and ten residential floors, offering a limited collection of 99 family-focused homes. The development includes a range of 1 to 3-bedroom apartments, some with maid’s rooms and storage spaces, all designed with spacious layouts, large windows, and a strong focus on natural light and everyday comfort.

The project is centered around lifestyle and well-being, providing a wide range of amenities including a temperature-controlled swimming pool, kids’ pool, modern gym, jogging track, yoga and meditation areas, jacuzzi, steam and sauna facilities, as well as landscaped spaces and dedicated children’s play areas. Residents also benefit from a lounge, BBQ and entertainment areas, pet-friendly zones, and 24/7 security, creating a balanced and community-oriented living environment.

Interiors are designed with a focus on functionality and quality, featuring high ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, and well-proportioned layouts. Apartments include fitted wardrobes, modern kitchens with cabinets, countertops, and essential appliances, as well as fully finished bathrooms with quality sanitary fittings. Each unit comes with central air conditioning, double-glazed windows, and smart home-ready infrastructure, ensuring comfort and efficiency in everyday living.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a residential community situated in close proximity to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and other popular areas in Dubai. It covers an area of approximately 560 hectares and consists of both villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse range of housing options for residents.

The community is known for its well-planned infrastructure and thoughtfully designed properties. It features a mix of architectural styles, including Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs, creating a visually appealing and diverse atmosphere.

In terms of amenities, Al Furjan offers a range of facilities to enhance the quality of life for its residents. These include landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centers, swimming pools, sports courts, and cycling and jogging tracks. There are also retail centers within the community that provide convenient access to shopping, dining, and other essential services.
